recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-5514 unless Pharmacy separately chooses to revise modern MedicationRequest wording or examples.
issue_request: FHIR-5514 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy request to update MedicationPrescription.medication and MedicationPrescription.dispense.medication from an older either/or definition to wording clarifying that the element identifies the medication and may link to a Medication resource that is detailed or code-only, with examples for both forms.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5514 was found. The requested wording appears in the imported R2-era MedicationOrder source for MedicationOrder.medication[x] and MedicationOrder.dispenseRequest.medication[x]. Later commits removed MedicationOrder.dispenseRequest.medication[x], renamed MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest, and changed the active definition from 'being administered' to the context-appropriate 'being requested'.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is not an active current resource; source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest=MedicationRequest and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Current MedicationRequest.medication is a CodeableReference(Medication), current dispenseRequest has no medication child, and current examples include both a Medication reference and a coded concept. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant FHIR-5514 discussion or minutes that would alter the source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reverting the active wording to 'being administered' would make MedicationRequest less correct, and reintroducing dispenseRequest.medication would undo a later model removal.
